title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 044 ]

blocks.text: A healthy diet is important for children as well as adults. When adults have poor eating habits, their children usually do, too. After all, children eat the same way as their parents do. When parents eat healthy food, the children will think it tastes good.
